name: Lyons
tagline: What did our local government just do?
about: Short recaps of Lyons public meetings, written from the meeting captions and read by two AI voices. Every fact links to the moment in the meeting where it was said. An episode that passes every check is published; one that fails a check waits for an editor, who can edit, unpublish or kill any episode.
